from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    borrowed = rng.choice(["borrowed_button", "tin_whistle", "cracked_marble"])
    owner = "owner_elsie"
    request = rng.choice(["display", "pad", "return"])
    fragile = borrowed != "old_key"
    space = rng.choice(["roomy", "crowded"])
    tool = rng.choice(["velvet_pad", "lamp", "rope"])
    mark = rng.choice(["maker_mark", "family_mark"])

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "bo": {"name": "Bo", "kind": "child"},
        "pip": {"name": "Pip", "kind": "magpie"},
        "mara": {"name": "Mara", "kind": "keeper"},
        owner: {"name": "Elsie", "kind": "owner"},
        "museum_gallery": {"name": "museum gallery", "kind": "place"},
        "worktable": {"name": "worktable", "kind": "place"},
        "display_case": {"name": "display case", "kind": "place"},
        "courtyard": {"name": "courtyard", "kind": "place"},
        "borrowed_button": {"name": "borrowed button", "kind": "prop"},
        "old_key": {"name": "old key", "kind": "prop"},
        "cracked_marble": {"name": "cracked marble", "kind": "prop"},
        "tin_whistle": {"name": "tin whistle", "kind": "prop"},
        "label_cards": {"name": "label cards", "kind": "prop"},
        "magnifying_glass": {"name": "magnifying glass", "kind": "prop"},
        "velvet_pad": {"name": "velvet pad", "kind": "prop"},
        "rope": {"name": "rope", "kind": "prop"},
        "lamp": {"name": "lamp", "kind": "prop"},
        "owner_letter": {"name": "owner letter", "kind": "prop"},
        "returning_box": {"name": "returning box", "kind": "prop"},
        "signboard": {"name": "signboard", "kind": "prop"},
    }

    initial = {
        "ada.location": "museum_gallery",
        "bo.location": "museum_gallery",
        "pip.location": "museum_gallery",
        "mara.location": "museum_gallery",
        "owner_elsie.location": "courtyard",
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": 2,
        "ada.memes.Care": 1,
        "bo.memes.Craft": 2,
        "bo.memes.Curiosity": 1,
        "pip.memes.Curiosity": 1,
        "mara.memes.Care": rng.randint(1, 2),
        "ada.knows.object": None,
        "ada.knows.mark": None,
        "ada.knows.request": None,
        "bo.knows.object": None,
        "bo.knows.space": None,
        "mara.knows.request": None,
        "borrowed_button.location": "museum_gallery",
        "old_key.location": "museum_gallery",
        "cracked_marble.location": "museum_gallery",
        "tin_whistle.location": "museum_gallery",
        "borrowed_button.owner": "owner_elsie",
        "old_key.owner": "museum",
        "cracked_marble.owner": "museum",
        "tin_whistle.owner": "owner_elsie",
        "borrowed_button.fragile": borrowed == "borrowed_button",
        "old_key.fragile": False,
        "cracked_marble.fragile": True,
        "tin_whistle.fragile": False,
        "borrowed_button.condition": "sound",
        "old_key.condition": "worn",
        "cracked_marble.condition": "cracked",
        "tin_whistle.condition": "sound",
        "borrowed_button.mark": mark,
        "tin_whistle.mark": mark,
        "cracked_marble.mark": "quarry_mark",
        "owner_elsie.request": request,
        "owner_elsie.approved": False,
        "owner_elsie.note_ready": True,
        "display_case.space": space,
        "display_case.stable": False,
        "display_case.open": False,
        "display_case.label_accurate": False,
        "display_case.borrowed_displayed": False,
        "display_case.rope_used": False,
        "display_case.pad_used": False,
        "display_case.lamp_used": False,
        "display_case.substitute_ready": False,
        "velvet_pad.owner": "mara",
        "lamp.owner": "mara",
        "rope.owner": "mara",
        "returning_box.owner": "mara",
        "velvet_pad.location": "worktable",
        "lamp.location": "worktable",
        "rope.location": "worktable",
        "returning_box.location": "worktable",
        "label_cards.location": "worktable",
        "signboard.location": "worktable",
        "owner_letter.location": "worktable",
        "magnifying_glass.location": "worktable",
        "borrowed_object": borrowed,
        "needed_tool": tool,
        "museum.open": False,
        "exhibit.focus": "none",
    }

    scenes = [
        observe(
            "inspect_borrowed", "ada", borrowed,
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
                      C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
                      C(borrowed + ".location", "eq", "museum_gallery")),
            summary="Ada inspected the borrowed object"),
        observe(
            "inspect_mark", "pip", borrowed,
            requires=(C("pip.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
                      C(borrowed + ".location", "eq", "museum_gallery")),
            summary="Pip noticed a mark on the borrowed object"),
        tell(
            "share_finding", "ada", "bo", "ada.knows.object",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.object", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Bo what she learned about the object"),
        Scene(
            "read_owner_request", "care", ("mara", "ada"),
            (C("mara.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
             C("owner_elsie.note_ready", "eq", True),
             C("ada.location", "eq", "museum_gallery")),
            (E("mara.knows.request", "copy", "owner_elsie.request"),
             E("ada.knows.request", "copy", "owner_elsie.request"),
             E("owner_elsie.approved", True)),
            "Mara read the owner's request with Ada", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "test_case", "observation", ("bo", "mara", "display_case"),
            (C("bo.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
             C("mara.location", "eq", "museum_gallery")),
            (E("bo.knows.space", "copy", "display_case.space"),
             E("bo.memes.Craft", 1)),
            "Bo tested the display case and judged its space", 1.0, 1),
        transfer(
            "lend_pad", "mara", "ada", "velvet_pad",
            requires=(C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                      C("velvet_pad.owner", "eq", "mara")),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the velvet pad"),
        transfer(
            "lend_lamp", "mara", "bo", "lamp",
            requires=(C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                      C("lamp.owner", "eq", "mara")),
            summary="Mara lent Bo the lamp"),
        transfer(
            "lend_rope", "mara", "ada", "rope",
            requires=(C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                      C("rope.owner", "eq", "mara")),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the rope"),
        Scene(
            "make_space", "cooperation", ("ada", "bo", "pip"),
            (C("ada.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
             C("bo.location", "eq", "museum_gallery"),
             C("bo.knows.space", "eq", "crowded"),
             C("ada.knows.object", "ne", None)),
            (E("display_case.space", "roomy"),
             E("pip.location", "eq", "display_case"),
             E("bo.memes.Craft", 1)),
            "The children cleared space in the case", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "prepare_display", "care", ("ada", "bo"),
            (C("ada.knows.request", "in", ("display", "pad")),
             C("ada.knows.object", "ne", None),
             C("display_case.space", "eq", "roomy"),
             C("owner_elsie.approved", "eq", True)),
            (E("display_case.borrowed_displayed", True),
             E("display_case.pad_used", "eq", "pad"),
             E("display_case.lamp_used", True),
             E("display_case.focus", "copy", "borrowed_object")),
            "The children arranged the borrowed treasure carefully", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "prepare_return_exhibit", "cooperation", ("ada", "bo", "pip"),
            (C("ada.knows.request", "eq", "return"),
             C("ada.knows.object", "ne", None)),
            (E("display_case.substitute_ready", True),
             E("display_case.focus", "eq", "old_key"),
             E("returning_box.location", "eq", "worktable")),
            "The team built the exhibit around an old key", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "write_label", "craft", ("ada", "bo"),
            (C("ada.knows.mark", "ne", None),
             C("ada.knows.request", "ne", None),
             C("display_case.focus", "ne", "none")),
            (E("display_case.label_accurate", True),
             E("label_cards.location", "display_case")),
            "Ada wrote an accurate label for the exhibit", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "return_object", "care", ("ada", "mara"),
            (C("ada.knows.request", "eq", "return"),
             C("borrowed_object", "ne", "none"),
             C("returning_box.location", "eq", "worktable"),
             C("display_case.substitute_ready", "eq", True)),
            (E("borrowed_object.location", "courtyard"),
             E("returning_box.location", "courtyard"),
             E("borrowed_object.owner", "owner_elsie")),
            "Mara returned the borrowed object in its box", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "open_exhibit", "cooperation", ("mara", "ada", "bo"),
            (C("display_case.label_accurate", "eq", True),
             C("display_case.stable", "eq", True),
             C("display_case.focus", "ne", "none")),
            (E("display_case.open", True),
             E("museum.open", True)),
            "Mara opened the stable small exhibit", 1.0, 1),
        Scene(
            "stabilize_display", "craft", ("bo", "ada"),
            (C("display_case.focus", "ne", "none"),
             C("display_case.label_accurate", "eq", True),
             C("display_case.space", "eq", "roomy")),
            (E("display_case.stable", True)),
            "Bo checked that the arrangement was stable", 1.0, 1),
    ]

    # Correct the borrowed-object indirection through explicit, seed-selected effects.
    for scene in scenes:
        if scene.id == "prepare_display":
            scene.effects = tuple(
                E("display_case.borrowed_displayed", True)
                if effect.key == "display_case.borrowed_displayed" else effect
                for effect in scene.effects
            )

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "no_unapproved_borrowed_display",
            (C("display_case.borrowed_displayed", "eq", False),),
            (C("owner_elsie.approved", "eq", False),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "open_only_stable",
            (C("display_case.open", "eq", False),),
            (C("display_case.stable", "eq", False),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "accurate_label_required",
            (C("display_case.open", "eq", False),),
            (C("display_case.label_accurate", "eq", False),),
        ),
    )

    goal = (
        C("museum.open", "eq", True),
        C("display_case.label_accurate", "eq", True),
        C("display_case.stable", "eq", True),
    )

    labels = {
        "display_case.focus": "exhibit focus",
        "display_case.borrowed_displayed": "borrowed treasure displayed",
        "display_case.label_accurate": "accurate label",
        "display_case.stable": "stable arrangement",
        "museum.open": "museum exhibit open",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "The Museum of Small Things",
        entities,
        initial,
        scenes,
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
